scope: One named public UI/UX skill and its unchanged same-project design colour database. Ten paired trials only; not representative full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: 2026-11-09: separately frozen public palette contrast task after 86 passing sandbox checks. Earlier source freezes, results and timings remain unchanged; Node compilation caches remain disabled.

runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

cases.task_request:
Audit the supplied original public palette database for a proposed interface whose normal-sized body text and CTA button labels both use each palette's Text (Hex) colour. Read only /inputs/colors.csv. For every CSV row, evaluate body_text: Text (Hex) on Background (Hex), and cta_label: Text (Hex) on CTA (Hex). This explicit label mapping is part of this request, not a claim about a deployed interface. Review these pairings only; do not generate a design system, install software, call external services, or alter the source CSV.
Use WCAG 2.2 AA normal-text contrast: convert each 8-bit sRGB channel to c in [0,1]; linearize as c/12.92 when c <= 0.04045, otherwise ((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4. Relative luminance is 0.2126*R+0.7152*G+0.0722*B. Contrast is (lighter+0.05)/(darker+0.05). A pair fails only if its unrounded ratio is strictly below 4.5.
Write /work/palette-contrast.json as one JSON object with exactly these fields: standard (the string WCAG-2.2-AA-normal-text), threshold (the number 4.5), total_palettes (integer CSV row count), total_pairs (integer evaluated pair count), passing_pairs (integer), failing_pairs (integer), and failures (array of objects). Every failure object must have exactly palette_id (integer from No), role (body_text or cta_label), and contrast_ratio (a string with exactly four digits after the decimal point, rounded to nearest). Include every failing pair and no passing pair. Sort failures by numeric palette_id and then role in lexical order. Derive counts from the actual CSV, not the guide's advertised inventory sizes. Do not include markdown, extra fields or prose in the file. The actual file, not a claimed result, is the deliverable. Available Python is the standard library only.
public_input_search: Reviewed the original guide sections on accessibility, typography/colour, and choosing existing palette data.
Selected the unchanged same-project public design reference CSV, not invented or altered palette data.
cases.verifier_policy: Reference values are computed only in the trusted parent from the frozen CSV. Neither verifier code nor its reference answer enters compiler/executor prompts or the container.
cases.fixture_validation: 86 sandboxed tests passed including an actual local-container control proving read-only CSV and independently accepted JSON deliverable. Trusted setup controls are not model executions.
cases.interpretation: Contrast failures concern only the two benchmark-defined foreground/background pairings, not a claim that the source project or a deployed interface violates accessibility rules.

storage_policy: Only this bounded named-source extension is authorized. Stop before a new stage below the one-billion-byte shared-volume reserve. Never overwrite or rerun a retained incomplete stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: The isolated fixture controls use no models. Existing valid guarded text receipts are reused, avoiding extra paid availability probes; each new stage still rejects unreported or unexpected serving identity and tools.
